name: Whipvine Arrow deals Nature damage and roots its target natively (#3630)
contract: 806342 'Whipvine Arrow' reads 'Launch an arrow ... dealing ... Nature damage and rooting them ...'. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_ROOT (APPLY_AURA) and effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE (SchoolMask 8 = Nature, BasePoints 77+1=78 flat), both native effect types dispatched by the generic engine (SpellEffects.cpp) with no script needed. CasterAuraSpell 804329 (SPELL_ADVANTAGE) gates the cast on having at least one stack of Advantage; EquippedItemClass is -1 (unrestricted), so no weapon is required despite SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT (that attribute only controls the projectile visual flag in Spell::SendSpellStart, not a CheckItems weapon gate). Separately, no delivery mechanism exists anywhere in this tree for the tooltip's 'additional target per stack of Advantage' clause: EffectChainTarget/MaxAffectedTargets are static DBC values (5/6), none of the four Advantage companion auras (704337, 801429, 801700, 802612) carry a class mask matching Whipvine Arrow's own SpellFamilyFlags (65536,0,0) word0 bit 16, and ApplyAdditionalTargetContracts (src/server/coa/AscensionClassMechanics.cpp) is a fixed 8-entry whitelist that does not name 806342. That clause is not exercised by this scenario and appears genuinely undelivered, not merely untested; only the literal damage+root behavior this issue reports is asserted here. 806342 has a 5-30 yd range (min range 5 yd); the fixture creature needs an explicit distance (default is 0, inside the minimum range, which fails the cast with SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE/128 before the root or damage is ever applied).

steps.label: Grant one stack of Advantage so the cast is not rejected
baseline: the target carries no root yet
